name: Endless Recursion
hint: If a custom block calls itself inside its body and has no condition to stop the recursion, it will run for an indefinite amount of time.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
define Jump
move (10) steps
turn left (180) degrees
move (10) steps
turn right (180) degrees
Jump :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛

when green flag clicked
Jump
say [I am great!]

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
define Jump
move (10) steps
turn left (180) degrees
move (10) steps
turn right (180) degrees
if <not<touching (edge v)> >then :: #007000 //⇦  👍
Jump
end

when green flag clicked
Jump
say [I am great!]
